name: persist a sample file matching a standard distribution
definition: write at least one sample file containing sample values aligned with the mean/std (or shape) of an expected standard marginal.
failure_mode: missing/short/off-distribution sample files fail the sample-file checks

name: produce out-of-sample predictions one value per sample
definition: apply a fitted regression to the held-out input and write exactly one numeric prediction per sample in order.
failure_mode: wrong line count, uniform values, out-of-range, or copied values fail the checks.
